skill.name: lfs-video-face-swap
skill.description: Use Live Face Swap to estimate credits, prepare and start approved face swaps for prerecorded MP4s, and retrieve results.
skill.summary: Estimate credits, start approved video face swaps, and find the finished MP4.
skill.author: aloow

security_audit.summary: The setup connects the assistant to a remote MCP server with user-approved OAuth access. The guide link, Markdown backticks, and approval error handler do not indicate hidden requests, shell execution, or system reconnaissance. The workflow requires permission to use the portrait but does not require permission from the person in the source video.

remediation.issue: The setup connects to a remote MCP provider.
remediation.suggestion: Before login, show the provider domain, requested OAuth scope, and how to revoke access. Link to the provider's media handling and retention policies before upload.

remediation.issue: The workflow does not check consent for the person in the source video.
remediation.suggestion: Before preparing a job, require permission from the people depicted in both inputs for the edit and its intended distribution. State that quote approval does not establish consent.

finding_verdicts.reason: This URL configures a remote MCP server that receives task requests after the user grants OAuth access. The connection is intentional but extends trust to the provider.
The backticks format an MCP quote tool and its fields. The instruction requests a credit estimate, not shell execution.
The backticks format the MCP preparation tool and response fields. The instruction leaves source file selection in the browser and does not invoke a shell.
The backticks format a job creation tool and identifiers. The instruction requires price approval and an explicit start request before calling the MCP tool.
The backticks format a service error code and the draft identifier. The instruction describes approval recovery and retrying the MCP request, not running a shell command.
The backticks format a status lookup tool, task identifier, and retry field. The instruction only directs the assistant to query the selected MCP connection.
The backticks format task states, billed credits, and a result URL. The instruction reports these fields and leaves MP4 preview and download to the browser.
The URL is a setup guide to show when the MCP tools are unavailable. The instruction does not ask the assistant to fetch it or send data to it.
The instruction handles approval errors, draft expiry, quote changes, and unclear start outcomes. It does not inspect the host, environment, or credentials.

content.user_title: Manage Video Face Swaps with Live Face Swap
content.value_statement: A short video face swap can require separate steps for pricing, approval, and retrieval. Use the assistant to estimate credits, start the job after approval, and find the finished MP4.
actual_capabilities: Estimate credits for a clip lasting 1 to 30 seconds without preparing or starting a job.
Create a draft and provide a private browser link for media selection and price approval.
Start the approved draft after an explicit request and retain the task ID for status checks.
Check an existing task and report its status and any billed credits returned.
Share the private result page for browser preview and MP4 download.
limitations: Requires a Live Face Swap account and an MCP client that supports Streamable HTTP, OAuth with PKCE, and dynamic client registration.
Accepts a prerecorded MP4 lasting 1 to 30 seconds with one visible face.
Media selection and exact quote approval happen in the browser. The preparation link expires after 30 minutes.
The result page finishes the video in the browser. The assistant provides the link rather than the MP4 file.

use_cases.title: Budget a Short Video Edit
use_cases.description: Get a credit estimate using clip length before choosing or uploading media.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Authorized Prototype
use_cases.description: Get a private preparation link for a demo clip after securing consent from the people depicted.

use_cases.title: Resume a Submitted Job
use_cases.description: Use an existing task ID to check progress and retrieve the private download page once the task is complete.

prompt_templates.title: Estimate Credits Only
prompt_templates.prompt: Estimate credits for a 10-second MP4. Do not prepare or start a job.
prompt_templates.scenario: Check the estimated cost before selecting media.

prompt_templates.title: Request a Preparation Link
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a face swap for my 12-second MP4 and portrait. I have permission from everyone depicted. Send the preparation link privately and do not start the job.
prompt_templates.scenario: Select media and approve the exact quote in the browser.

prompt_templates.title: Start the Approved Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: I approved the exact quote on the Live Face Swap site. Start that approved draft and give me the task ID.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start the job after approving the exact price.

prompt_templates.title: Retrieve an Existing Result
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the existing task with the ID I provide. If complete, share the private result link and any billed credits. Do not start another job.
prompt_templates.scenario: Resume a task without submitting the media again.

output_examples.input: Prepare a draft for my authorized clip, but do not start it.
output: Your draft is ready. The private preparation link expires in 30 minutes.
Open it in your browser to select the MP4 and portrait and review the exact quote.

output_examples.input: Check my existing task and share the result if it is complete.
output: Use the private result link to finish the video in your browser, preview it, and download the MP4.

best_practices: Get informed consent from everyone depicted for the edit and any planned sharing.
Use the same Live Face Swap account to open the preparation link and approve the exact quote.
Keep the task ID and share preparation and result links only with authorized recipients.
anti_patterns: Treating a credit estimate as approval to start a job.
Sending the MP4 or portrait in chat instead of using the preparation page.
Submitting a new job immediately after a timeout instead of retrying the same draft.

faq.question: What do I need to connect?
faq.answer: Use a Live Face Swap account and an MCP client with Streamable HTTP, OAuth with PKCE, and dynamic client registration.

faq.question: What video can I use?
faq.answer: Use a prerecorded MP4 lasting 1 to 30 seconds with one clearly visible face. You also need a portrait you have permission to use.

faq.question: When is the exact price available?
faq.answer: The early estimate uses clip length. The site shows the exact quote after you select the files, and credits are reserved when the approved job starts.

faq.question: Where do I provide my files?
faq.answer: Select the MP4 and portrait on the private preparation page using the same Live Face Swap account. Do not upload them to the assistant chat.

faq.question: What happens if the link expires or the price changes?
faq.answer: Ask for a new preparation link and review and approve the new quote before requesting a start.

faq.question: How do I download a finished video?
faq.answer: Ask for the result using the task ID. Open the private result page to finish the video in your browser, then preview or download the MP4.
